registry_entry.intent: Public, no-login encyclopedia of ultimate frisbee drills/strategies/formations/plays/skills plus full-text search & attribute filtering (PRD Features 1-2), built into the existing Vite React SPA + FastAPI/Supabase backend via a polymorphic entries schema, EncyclopediaService facade, and react-router-dom; encyclopedia owns '/', intake form relocates to /contribute.

feat/encyclopedia-foundation.intent: Blocking backend root: entries/tags/entry_tags/media schema (migration 006), EncyclopediaService facade (search_entries/get_entry/get_similar) with Factory Method/Flyweight/Chain of Responsibility/Strategy patterns, and read-only /api/entries, /api/entries/{type}/{slug}, /api/search endpoints. status='published' gating enforced at the service layer.

feat/frontend-routing.intent: Frontend routing scaffold: introduces react-router-dom, mounts encyclopedia shell at '/' (placeholder) and existing intake app at /contribute/*, audits intake for root-path-dependent assumptions (localStorage keys, absolute nav) and fixes any found.

feat/encyclopedia-browse.intent: PRD Feature 1 (The Encyclopedia): homepage, five section browse pages via one type-parameterized Section.tsx, entry detail template with self-omitting sections + tag-overlap Similar Entries; replaces routing placeholder root

feat/encyclopedia-search.intent: PRD Feature 2 (Search, Filtering & Discovery): persistent header search bar, /search results page, AND-across/OR-within filter panel + chips, sort controls, non-dead-end empty state

feat/encyclopedia-seo-polish.intent: Partition 5 convergence: Seo.tsx (helmet + JSON-LD HowTo), build-time sitemap, loading skeletons + error/retry states, accessibility pass (aria/keyboard/contrast/reduced-motion), plus merge consolidations (search restyle to Light Film Room, type dedup, film-* tokens, mobile header search)
